title: Lattices · shapes made of particles
description: Lattices on the GPU engine (src/lattice.ts, src/fight-particles.ts): shapes whose particles hold together, each drawn to its home and to its neighbours. A wall that thrown sparks dent, hole and knock apart and that mends itself; a ball that morphs into a crystal, a ring and a column keeping its structure, shaken by pushes; a ring that streams round itself in waves; a veil of cloth that drapes over a dog; embers that assemble into a crystal that bursts; a shield shaped like an escutcheon that takes a volley and shatters; and three spheres round a dog that deflect blows from every side and pop: bands with glass between them, bands both ways, and glass dots alone, which a last volley shatters like the shield. Played on a dog in a real fight with effects.fightFx, captured at twice the pixels (--gpu --scale 2) on the game's clock at 30 fps. Matemágico's two: a soap film between two gold rings round Gerard (a catenoid painted by its thickness) that two blows ripple and a third bursts, its droplets thrown back at the striker as water; the same film left to drain to black film and come apart in motes; and a string of light between Gerard's chest and a dog's, plucked four times harder each time, each pulse flipping over at the end it reaches, then snapping in the middle.

steps.eval: window.lab = (() => { const g = window.gerard.game; document.querySelector('#battle').style.visibility = 'hidden'; const ids = g.fighterIds(), foe = ids.filter(f => !f.party)[1].id, ally = ids.find(f => f.party).id; return { look({ up = .7, toward = 0, height = 1.5 } = {}) { g.effects.clear(); const f = g.fighterAt(foe), a = g.fighterAt(ally), dx = a.x - f.x, dz = a.z - f.z, d = Math.hypot(dx, dz) || 1; g.frame({ x: f.x + dx / d * toward, y: f.y + up, z: f.z + dz / d * toward }, height); }, play(name, o = {}) { g.effects.clear(); return g.fx(name, foe, { from: ally, ...o }); } }; })();

steps.caption: Ward: a wall of light between the dog and the blows. Sparks dent it, punch holes and knock bits loose that fall; it draws them back and mends, then crumbles from the top
Morph: a ball becomes a crystal, a ring, a column and a ball again, every point keeping its neighbours; two pushes shake it like jelly and it springs back
Current: a ring of threads round the dog streams round itself in waves, tightens, runs faster and breaks into motes
Veil: cloth of light falls on the dog, drapes over its back and head and lies on the floor, then frays away from its edges
Forge: embers fly in from all round and bond into a crystal over the dog; it turns, then bursts from its heart into chips that rain down

Shield: an escutcheon of light with a bright rim and a boss unfolds between the dog and the blows. Sparks glance off it, dent it and knock bits loose; it mends; a last heavy volley shatters it from where it lands

Bubble: bands of light round the dog (the sphere's parallels) with glass facets between them. It spreads as a disc at its feet, swells round it and turns; blows from three sides glance off and dent it, it heals at once, then pops
Globe: the same sphere with bands both ways, parallels and meridians, and the glass between them

Orb: a sphere of glass made of the shield's dots alone, see-through where it faces you (opacity, fresnel and glass dots) and bright round its outline. A last heavy volley shatters it from where it lands, like the shield
The orb with nothing see-through (opacity 1, fresnel 0): a solid ball of dots that hides the dogs

steps.eval: window.lab2 = (() => { const g = window.gerard.game; const ids = g.fighterIds(), foe = ids.filter(f => !f.party)[1].id, ally = ids.find(f => f.party).id; return { ally, foe, at(id, up, h) { g.effects.clear(); const f = g.fighterAt(id); g.frame({ x: f.x, y: f.y + up, z: f.z }, h); }, mid(up, h) { g.effects.clear(); const f = g.fighterAt(foe), a = g.fighterAt(ally); g.frame({ x: (f.x + a.x) / 2, y: (f.y + a.y) / 2 + up, z: (f.z + a.z) / 2 }, h); }, play(name, target, from) { g.effects.clear(); return g.fx(name, target, { from }); } }; })();

steps.caption: Film: two gold rings part from Gerard's chest to his ankles and over his head, and a soap film forms between them, a catenoid narrowing at the waist, coloured by its thickness (gold, white, cyan, water blue). Two blows send capillary ripples across it; a third bursts it: the hole's bright rim runs back across it and the droplets it sheds fly at the striker as water
Film left alone: it drains, turns black film from the top down (its colours go out) and comes apart in a few motes with its rings

String: a string of light (400 members) drawn from Gerard's chest to the dog's. Four plucks, harder each time: a pulse runs to one end, alternately, and flips over there with a flash; then it snaps in the middle and each half recoils onto its end
